Definition: Asahel, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Asahel is the name of four Israelites, and the chief of them is the brother of Joab, swift of foot as a wild roe. He chases Abner across the field at Gibeon and will not turn aside, and Abner smites him under the fifth rib; and the chronicler names him captain of David's monthly course, his son Zebadiah after him.
TheologicalSignificance: A swift runner who would not turn aside tells me that courage without counsel can kill a man: Asahel's speed was real, and so was the spear that met him, and David's army kept his name on the roster all the same.
